description: `{ [K in Keys]: Value }` creates one property per member of the key union.
A mapped type over `keyof T`. It keeps `readonly` and `?` modifiers, maps arrays and tuples to arrays and tuples, and passes primitives through.
`+readonly`/`-readonly` and `+?`/`-?` add or remove modifiers. `+` is the default.
Reads the type of property `K` of `T`; inside a mapped type it refers to the current property.
